Base directory for this skill: D:\code\invesments\master_investments_mmo\.claude\skills\cook # Cook - Smart Feature Implementation End-to-end implementation with automatic workflow detection. **Principles:** YAGNI, KISS, DRY | Token efficiency | Concise reports ## Usage ``` /ck:cook ``` **IMPORTANT:** If no flag is provided, the skill will use the `interactive` mode by default for the workflow. **Optional flags to select the workflow mode:** - `--interactive`: Full workflow with user input (**default**) - `--fast`: Skip research, scout→plan→code - `--parallel`: Multi-agent execution - `--no-test`: Skip testing step - `--auto`: Auto-approve all steps **Composable flags** (combine with any mode): - `--tdd`: Tests-first per phase — write tests for current behavior before refactoring, then verify they still pass after the implementation step **Example:** ``` /ck:cook "Add user authentication to the app" --fast /ck:cook path/to/plan.md --auto /ck:cook "Refactor auth middleware" --tdd ``` Do NOT write implementation code until a plan exists and has been reviewed. This applies regardless of task simplicity. "Simple" tasks are where unexamined assumptions waste the most time. Exception: `--fast` mode skips research but still requires a plan step. User override: If user explicitly says "just code it" or "skip planning", respect their instruction. Before planning OR asking clarifying questions, scan the codebase. Mandatory scout outputs: 1. Project type, language(s), framework(s) 2. Existing modules/files relevant to the task 3. Current patterns/conventions for similar features (so the implementation matches them) 4. Existing docs in `./docs/` and any in-flight plans in `./plans/` covering this area 5. Public APIs, schemas, contracts that the task could affect State a 3-6 bullet codebase-context summary to the user before asking questions. Skip ONLY when input is a `plan.md`/`phase-*.md` path (the plan already encodes scout output). Before producing a plan, you MUST be able to answer ALL of these in one concrete sentence each (use `AskUserQuestion` to pin them down — do NOT proceed on vague intent): 1. **Expected output**: the concrete artifact(s) the user will see at the end (file paths, feature behavior, UI screen, API endpoint + payload, CLI command + flags). 2. **Acceptance criteria**: specific behaviors / inputs → outputs / edge cases that MUST work to call it "done". 3. **Scope boundary**: what is explicitly OUT of scope this round. 4. **Non-negotiable constraints**: stack, file locations, naming, backward compatibility, deadlines, performance. 5. **Touchpoints**: which existing files/modules (from scout) will be modified or extended; which contracts must stay stable. Ground every `AskUserQuestion` option in scout findings (e.g., "Add to `src/api/users.ts` (matches existing pattern) or new `src/api/profile.ts`?"). Skip ONLY when input is a `plan.md`/`phase-*.md` path. Implementation is NOT done until verified to be side-effect-free. Code-review and test gates MUST prove: 1. New behavior matches every acceptance criterion above. 2. All tests pass — including tests in modules that share files/contracts with the change. 3. No existing business logic / workflow regression: explicitly walk each touchpoint and any caller of changed functions. 4. No new lint/type/build errors anywhere in the repo. 5. Public contracts unchanged unless intentional and called out (function signatures, exported types, API responses, DB schemas, env vars, config keys). User override: If user invoked `--no-test`, item 2 is downgraded to a warning. Surface the unverified-tests risk in the finalize `AskUserQuestion` so the user accepts the trade-off rather than having it silently chosen. Items 1, 3, 4, 5 remain enforceable via the mandatory `code-reviewer` subagent. If review/testing reveals a side effect, regression, or broken workflow, STOP. Use `AskUserQuestion` to present: - What broke (file, test, workflow, user-facing behavior) - Why this implementation caused it (1-line cause) - 2-4 concrete options for the user to choose, e.g.: - "Revert this slice and re-plan with stricter scope" - "Keep the implementation and update to match the new contract" - "Add a compatibility shim at so old callers keep working" - "Accept the regression — old behavior was unintended/buggy" Let the user decide. Do not silently patch around regressions. ## Anti-Rationalization | Thought | Reality | |---------|---------| | "This is too simple to plan" | Simple tasks have hidden complexity. Plan takes 30 seconds. | | "I already know how to do this" | Knowing ≠ planning. Write it down. | | "Let me just start coding" | Undisciplined action wastes tokens. Plan first. | | "The user wants speed" | Fastest path = plan → implement → done. Not: implement → debug → rewrite. | | "I'll plan as I go" | That's not planning, that's hoping. | | "Just this once" | Every skip is "just this once." No exceptions. | ## Smart Intent Detection | Input Pattern | Detected Mode | Behavior | |---------------|---------------|----------| | Path to `plan.md` or `phase-*.md` | code | Execute existing plan | | Contains "fast", "quick" | fast | Skip research, scout→plan→code | | Contains "trust me", "auto" | auto | Auto-approve all steps | | Lists 3+ features OR "parallel" | parallel | Multi-agent execution | | Contains "no test", "skip test" | no-test | Skip testing step | | Default | interactive | Full workflow with user input | See `references/intent-detection.md` for detection logic. ## Process Flow (Authoritative) ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Intent Detection] --> B{Has plan path?} B -->|Yes| F[Load Plan] B -->|No| C{Mode?} C -->|fast| D[Scout → Plan → Code] C -->|interactive/auto| SC[Scout Codebase MANDATORY] SC --> SR[Summarize Findings to User] SR --> RQ{Exact requirements captured?
output, acceptance, scope, constraints, touchpoints} RQ -->|No| SR RQ -->|Yes| E[Research → Review → Plan] E --> F D --> F F --> G[Review Gate] G -->|approved| H[Implement] G -->|rejected| E H --> H1{Simplify signal?} H1 -->|Yes| H2[Conditional Simplify] H1 -->|No| I[Review Gate] H2 --> I I -->|approved| J{--no-test?} J -->|No| K[Test] J -->|Yes| L[Finalize] K --> L L --> M[Report + Journal] ``` **This diagram is the authoritative workflow.** Prose sections below provide detail for each node. If prose conflicts with this flow, follow the diagram. ## Workflow Overview ``` [Intent Detection] → [Research?] → [Review] → [Plan] → [Review] → [Implement] → [Conditional Simplify?] → [Review] → [Test?] → [Review] → [Finalize] ``` **Default (non-auto):** Stops at `[Review]` gates for human approval before each major step. **Auto mode (`--auto`):** Skips human review gates, implements all phases continuously. **Claude Tasks:** Utilize `TaskCreate`, `TaskUpdate`, `TaskGet`, `TaskList` during implementation step. **Fallback:** These are CLI-only tools — unavailable in VSCode extension. If they error, use `TodoWrite` for progress tracking instead. | Mode | Research | Testing | Review Gates | Phase Progression | |------|----------|---------|--------------|-------------------| | interactive | ✓ | ✓ | **User approval at each step** | One at a time | | auto | ✓ | ✓ | Auto if score≥9.5 | All at once (no stops) | | fast | ✗ | ✓ | **User approval at each step** | One at a time | | parallel | Optional | ✓ | **User approval at each step** | Parallel groups | | no-test | ✓ | ✗ | **User approval at each step** | One at a time | | code | ✗ | ✓ | **User approval at each step** | Per plan | ## Step Output Format ``` ✓ Step [N]: [Brief status] - [Key metrics] ``` ## Blocking Gates (Non-Auto Mode) Human review required at these checkpoints (skipped with `--auto`): - **Post-Research:** Review findings before planning - **Post-Plan:** Approve plan before implementation - **Post-Implementation:** Approve code before testing - **Post-Testing:** 100% pass + approve before finalize **Always enforced (all modes):** - **Testing:** 100% pass required (unless no-test mode) - **Code Review (MANDATORY):** Spawn `code-reviewer` subagent with explicit checks: (a) every acceptance criterion met, (b) no regression to business logic in touchpoints/blast-radius, (c) no breaking changes to public contracts (signatures, schemas, APIs, env vars) unless called out, (d) follows existing patterns from scout, (e) no new lint/type/build errors anywhere. Pass scout summary + acceptance criteria as context. If reviewer flags side effects → trigger HARD-GATE-NO-SIDE-EFFECTS (`AskUserQuestion` with 2-4 options). Then: User approval OR auto-approve (score≥9.5, 0 critical). - **Finalize (MANDATORY - never skip):** 1. **Activate `/ck:project-management` skill (MANDATORY)** → run full plan sync-back across ALL `phase-XX-*.md` (not only current phase), update `plan.md` status/progress, hydrate Claude Tasks, generate progress report 2. `docs-manager` subagent → update `./docs` if changes warrant 3. `TaskUpdate` → mark all Claude Tasks complete after sync-back verification (skip if Task tools unavailable) 4. Ask user if they want to commit via `git-manager` subagent 5. Run `/ck:journal` to write a concise technical journal entry upon completion ## Required Subagents (MANDATORY) | Phase | Subagent | Requirement | |-------|----------|-------------| | Research | `researcher` | Optional in fast/code | | Scout | `ck:scout` | Optional in code | | Plan | `planner` | Optional in code | | UI Work | `ui-ux-designer` | If frontend work | | Testing | `tester`, `debugger` | **MUST** spawn | | Review | `code-reviewer` | **MUST** spawn | | Finalize | `/ck:project-management` skill + `docs-manager`, `git-manager` subagents | **MUST** invoke all | **CRITICAL ENFORCEMENT:** - Steps 4, 5, 6 **MUST** use Task tool to spawn subagents - DO NOT implement testing, review, or finalization yourself - DELEGATE - If workflow ends with 0 Task tool calls, it is INCOMPLETE - Pattern: `Task(subagent_type="[type]", prompt="[task]", description="[brief]")` ## References - `references/intent-detection.md` - Detection rules and routing logic - `references/workflow-steps.md` - Detailed step definitions for all modes - `references/review-cycle.md` - Interactive and auto review processes - `references/subagent-patterns.md` - Subagent invocation patterns ## Workflow Position **Typically follows:** `/ck:plan` (execute a plan), `/ck:brainstorm` (implement agreed solution) **Typically precedes:** `/ck:code-review` (review after implementation), `/ck:test` (validate changes) **Related:** `/ck:fix` (alternative for bug fixes), `/ck:plan` (create plan before cooking) ARGUMENTS: plans/260602-brain4-flow-position-engine/plan.md

## Requirements
- Functional: Represent 5 position types (GATEWAY, AGGREGATOR, STANDARD, BOTTLENECK, DATA_EXHAUST) with volume, take rate, switching cost, network effect metrics
- Non-functional: Same serialization pattern as PriceDelta/ForcedFlow (to_dict, from_dict, __post_init__ auto-calc)

## Architecture
New dataclass in existing file. No new files. Follows exact same pattern as `PriceDelta` and `ForcedFlow`.

## Related Code Files

## Implementation Steps

1. Add `FlowPosition` dataclass after `ForcedFlow` (line ~101) with fields:
   ```python
   @dataclass
   class FlowPosition:
       flow_name: str                    # e.g. "VN AI API Gateway"
       position_type: str                # GATEWAY|AGGREGATOR|STANDARD|BOTTLENECK|DATA_EXHAUST
       market: str                       # geographic/industry market
       description: str = ""
       
       # Volume metrics
       estimated_daily_volume: float = 0.0    # transactions/day or requests/day
       volume_growth_rate: float = 0.0        # % monthly growth
       take_rate: float = 0.0                 # % per transaction
       monthly_revenue: float = 0.0           # auto-calc: volume * 30 * take_rate * avg_tx_value
       avg_transaction_value: float = 0.0     # $ per transaction
       
       # Position strength
       switching_cost: float = 0.0            # 0-1 (0=trivial, 1=impossible)
       alternative_count: int = 0             # known competitors
       network_effect: float = 0.0            # 0-1 (0=none, 1=strong two-sided)
       
       # Feasibility
       build_complexity: float = 0.0          # 0-1 (0=weekend, 1=years)
       capital_required: float = 0.0          # $ to reach first flow
       time_to_first_flow: int = 0            # days to first transaction
       
       confidence: str = "[?]"
       sources: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
       timestamp: str = field(default_factory=_now_iso)
   ```

   ```python
   def __post_init__(self):
       if self.monthly_revenue == 0.0 and self.estimated_daily_volume > 0 and self.take_rate > 0:
           self.monthly_revenue = self.estimated_daily_volume * 30 * self.take_rate * self.avg_transaction_value
   ```

   ```python
   def position_score(self) -> float:
       volume_factor = min(1.0, self.estimated_daily_volume / 10000) if self.estimated_daily_volume > 0 else 0.0
       moat = (self.switching_cost * 0.4 + (1 - min(self.alternative_count, 10) / 10) * 0.3 + self.network_effect * 0.3)
       feasibility = 1.0 - self.build_complexity
       return volume_factor * 0.3 + moat * 0.4 + feasibility * 0.3
   ```

4. Add `to_dict()` and `from_dict()` following existing pattern.

5. Add `VALID_POSITION_TYPES` constant:
   ```python
   VALID_POSITION_TYPES = {"GATEWAY", "AGGREGATOR", "STANDARD", "BOTTLENECK", "DATA_EXHAUST"}
   ```

   ```python
   def final_rank(self, mode: str = "combined") -> float:
       if mode == "trader" or self.anomaly_type != "FLOW_POSITION":
           # Existing logic: margin_per_unit based
           margin_factor = self.margin_per_unit / 1000 if self.margin_per_unit > 0 else 0.01
           trader_score = self.anomaly_score * margin_factor * max(self.founder_fit, 0.01) * max(self.urgency, 0.01)
           if mode == "trader":
               return trader_score
       
       if self.flow_position:
           # Owner-mode: volume x take_rate x position_strength
           fp = FlowPosition.from_dict(self.flow_position)
           owner_score = fp.position_score() * max(self.founder_fit, 0.01) * self.anomaly_score
           if mode == "owner":
               return owner_score
           # Combined: max of both signals
           return max(trader_score if 'trader_score' in dir() else 0, owner_score)
       
       return trader_score if 'trader_score' in dir() else 0.01
   ```

   ```python
           card.anomaly_score = min(1.0, card.anomaly_score + fp.position_score() * 0.2)
   ```

89	        return min(1.0, math.log10(max(1, self.total_forced_spend)) / 10)
90	
91	    def priority_score(self) -> float:
92	        gap = 1.0 if self.provider_gap else 0.3
93	        return self.urgency_score() * 0.4 + self.size_score() * 0.3 + gap * 0.3
94

96	        return asdict(self)

99	    def from_dict(cls, d: dict) -> "ForcedFlow":
100	        return cls(**{k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in cls.__dataclass_fields__})

1	"""
2	Brain 1: Price Delta Engine.
3	Finds SPECIFIC price spreads >30% between markets.
4	Python controls search templates. LLM parses raw text only.
5	"""
6	
7	import json
8	import logging
9	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
10	from typing import Callable, Optional
11	
12	from .models import PriceDelta, FounderProfile
13	
14	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	PRICE_SEARCH_TEMPLATES = [
17	    '"{product}" price per {unit} {market} 2025 2026',
18	    '"{product}" wholesale price {market}',
19	    '"{product}" export FOB price {market}',
20	    '"{product}" import CIF price {market}',
21	]
22	
23	BRIDGE_COST_TEMPLATES = [
24	    "shipping cost {market_a} to {market_b} {product}",
25	    "import tariff {product} {market_b}",
26	]
27	
28	DEFAULT_SEEDS = [
29	    "robusta coffee", "arabica coffee", "black pepper", "cashew nuts",
30	    "pangasius fish", "shrimp", "rubber", "cinnamon",
31	]
32	
33	DEFAULT_MARKETS = ["Vietnam", "EU", "US", "Japan", "China"]
34	
35	PRICE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT = """Extract price data from this text. Return JSON:
36	{{"product": "...", "price": <number>, "currency": "USD|EUR|VND|CNY|JPY", "unit": "kg|ton|lb|unit", "source_url": "..."}}
37	If multiple prices found, return the most recent wholesale/FOB price.
38	If no price found, return {{"product": "...", "price": null}}.
39	
40	Text:
41	{text}"""
42	
43	BRIDGE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT = """Extract shipping/tariff cost from this text. Return JSON:
44	{{"cost_type": "shipping|tariff|documentation", "amount": <number>, "currency": "USD", "per_unit": "kg|ton|container"}}
45	If no cost found, return {{"cost_type": "...", "amount": null}}.
46	
47	Text:
48	{text}"""
49	
50	CURRENCY_TO_USD = {
51	    "USD": 1.0,
52	    "EUR": 1.08,
53	    "VND": 0.000039,
54	    "CNY": 0.14,
55	    "JPY": 0.0065,
56	    "GBP": 1.27,
57	}
58	
59	UNIT_TO_KG = {
60	    "kg": 1.0,
61	    "ton": 1000.0,
62	    "lb": 0.4536,
63	    "unit": 1.0,
64	}
65	
66	
67	@dataclass
68	class BudgetTracker:
69	    max_calls: int = 30
70	    calls_used: int = 0
71	
72	    def can_call(self) -> bool:
73	        return self.calls_used < self.max_calls
74	
75	    def use(self) -> bool:
76	        if not self.can_call():
77	            return False
78	        self.calls_used += 1
79	        return True
80	
81	
82	class PriceDeltaEngine:
83	    def __init__(self, research_fn: Callable, llm_fn: Callable,
84	                 max_calls: int = 30, spread_threshold: float = 30.0):
85	        self.research_fn = research_fn
86	        self.llm_fn = llm_fn
87	        self.budget = BudgetTracker(max_calls=max_calls)
88	        self.spread_threshold = spread_threshold
89	
90	    def scan(self, seed_products: Optional[list[str]] = None,
91	             markets: Optional[list[str]] = None,
92	             founder: Optional[FounderProfile] = None,
93	             targeted_queries: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> list[PriceDelta]:
94	        products = self._resolve_seeds(seed_products, founder)
95	        markets = markets or DEFAULT_MARKETS
96	        pairs = self._generate_pairs(products, markets)
97	        logger.info(f"Scanning {len(pairs)} product×market pairs (budget: {self.budget.max_calls})"
98	                    f"{f' + {len(targeted_queries)} IC-targeted queries' if targeted_queries else ''}")
99	
100	        raw_prices: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
101	
102	        # IC-targeted queries first (hypothesis-guided)
103	        if targeted_queries:
104	            for query in targeted_queries:
105	                if not self.budget.can_call():
106	                    break
107	                raw = self.research_fn(query)
108	                if raw:
109	                    price_data = self._parse_price_from_raw(raw, query)
110	                    if price_data and price_data.get("price") is not None:
111	                        product = price_data.get("product", "unknown")
112	                        if product not in raw_prices:
113	                            raw_prices[product] = []
114	                        raw_prices[product].append(price_data)
115	        for product, market in pairs:
116	            if not self.budget.can_call():
117	                logger.warning("Budget exhausted during price collection")
118	                break
119	            price_data = self._search_price(product, market)
120	            if price_data and price_data.get("price") is not None:
121	                key = product
122	                if key not in raw_prices:
123	                    raw_prices[key] = []
124	                raw_prices[key].append({**price_data, "market": market})
125	
126	        deltas = []
127	        for product, entries in raw_prices.items():
128	            if len(entries) < 2:
129	                continue
130	            product_deltas = self._calculate_spreads(product, entries)
131	            for delta in product_deltas:
132	                if abs(delta.spread_pct) >= self.spread_threshold:
133	                    enriched = self._enrich_bridge_cost(delta)
134	                    deltas.append(enriched)
135	
136	        deltas.sort(key=lambda d: abs(d.net_margin_pct), reverse=True)
137	        logger.info(f"Found {len(deltas)} deltas above {self.spread_threshold}% threshold "
138	                    f"(used {self.budget.calls_used}/{self.budget.max_calls} calls)")
139	        return deltas
140	
141	    def _resolve_seeds(self, explicit: Optional[list[str]],
142	                       founder: Optional[FounderProfile]) -> list[str]:
143	        seeds = list(explicit or [])
144	        if founder:
145	            seeds.extend(founder.industries)
146	        if not seeds:
147	            seeds = DEFAULT_SEEDS[:5]
148	        seen = set()
149	        unique = []
150	        for s in seeds:
151	            sl = s.lower().strip()
152	            if sl not in seen:
153	                seen.add(sl)
154	                unique.append(s.strip())
155	        return unique
156	
157	    def _generate_pairs(self, products: list[str],
158	                        markets: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
159	        pairs = []
160	        for p in products:
161	            for m in markets:
162	                pairs.append((p, m))
163	                if len(pairs) * 2 > self.budget.max_calls:
164	                    return pairs
165	        return pairs
166	
167	    def _parse_price_from_raw(self, raw: str, query: str) -> Optional[dict]:
168	        """Parse price data from raw search results (used for IC-targeted queries)."""
169	        if not raw:
170	            return None
171	        try:
172	            prompt = PRICE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(text=raw[:2000])
173	            result = self.llm_fn(prompt)
174	            if isinstance(result, str):
175	                result = json.loads(result)
176	            if not result.get("market"):
177	                result["market"] = query[:50]
178	            return result
179	        except Exception as e:
180	            logger.warning(f"Parse failed for targeted query '{query[:60]}': {e}")
181	            return None
182	
183	    def _search_price(self, product: str, market: str) -> Optional[dict]:
184	        template = PRICE_SEARCH_TEMPLATES[0]
185	        query = template.format(product=product, unit="kg", market=market)
186	
187	        if not self.budget.use():
188	            return None
189	
190	        try:
191	            raw = self.research_fn(query)
192	        except Exception as e:
193	            logger.warning(f"Search failed for {product}/{market}: {e}")
194	            return None
195	
196	        if not raw:
197	            return None
198	
199	        try:
200	            prompt = PRICE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(text=raw[:2000])
201	            result = self.llm_fn(prompt)
202	            if isinstance(result, str):
203	                result = json.loads(result)
204	            return result
205	        except Exception as e:
206	            logger.warning(f"LLM extraction failed for {product}/{market}: {e}")
207	            return None
208	
209	    def _normalize_price_to_usd_per_kg(self, price: float, currency: str,
210	                                        unit: str) -> float:
211	        usd_rate = CURRENCY_TO_USD.get(currency.upper(), 1.0)
212	        kg_rate = UNIT_TO_KG.get(unit.lower(), 1.0)
213	        return (price * usd_rate) / kg_rate
214	
215	    def _calculate_spreads(self, product: str,
216	                           entries: list[dict]) -> list[PriceDelta]:
217	        normalized = []
218	        for e in entries:
219	            price_usd_kg = self._normalize_price_to_usd_per_kg(
220	                e["price"], e.get("currency", "USD"), e.get("unit", "kg")
221	            )
222	            normalized.append({**e, "price_usd_kg": price_usd_kg})
223	
224	        deltas = []
225	        for i, a in enumerate(normalized):
226	            for b in normalized[i + 1:]:
227	                if a["market"] == b["market"]:
228	                    continue
229	                low, high = (a, b) if a["price_usd_kg"] <= b["price_usd_kg"] else (b, a)
230	                spread = ((high["price_usd_kg"] - low["price_usd_kg"])
231	                          / low["price_usd_kg"] * 100) if low["price_usd_kg"] > 0 else 0
232	
233	                sources = []
234	                for x in [a, b]:
235	                    if x.get("source_url"):
236	                        sources.append(x["source_url"])
237	
238	                deltas.append(PriceDelta(
239	                    product=product,
240	                    market_a=low["market"],
241	                    market_b=high["market"],
242	                    price_a=low["price_usd_kg"],
243	                    price_b=high["price_usd_kg"],
244	                    currency="USD",
245	                    unit="kg",
246	                    spread_pct=spread,
247	                    confidence="[T]",
248	                    sources=sources,
249	                ))
250	        return deltas
251	
252	    def _enrich_bridge_cost(self, delta: PriceDelta) -> PriceDelta:
253	        if not self.budget.can_call():
254	            return delta
255	
256	        query = BRIDGE_COST_TEMPLATES[0].format(
257	            market_a=delta.market_a, market_b=delta.market_b, product=delta.product
258	        )
259	
260	        if not self.budget.use():
261	            return delta
262	
263	        try:
264	            raw = self.research_fn(query)
265	            if not raw:
266	                return delta
267	            prompt = BRIDGE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(text=raw[:2000])
268	            result = self.llm_fn(prompt)
269	            if isinstance(result, str):
270	                result = json.loads(result)
271	            if result and result.get("amount") is not None:
272	                cost_per_kg = self._normalize_price_to_usd_per_kg(
273	                    result["amount"], result.get("currency", "USD"),
274	                    result.get("per_unit", "kg")
275	                )
276	                delta.bridge_cost = cost_per_kg
277	                delta.net_margin = delta.price_b - delta.price_a - cost_per_kg
278	                if delta.price_a > 0:
279	                    delta.net_margin_pct = (delta.net_margin / delta.price_a) * 100
280	        except Exception as e:
281	            logger.warning(f"Bridge cost enrichment failed: {e}")
282	
283	        return delta
284

1	"""
2	Brain 3: Anomaly Cross-Reference Engine.
3	Triangulates Brain 1 (price deltas) + Brain 2 (forced flows) + founder profile
4	+ historical anomalies → ranked AnomalyCards. No web calls — pure computation.
5	"""
6	
7	import logging
8	from typing import Optional
9	
10	from .models import PriceDelta, ForcedFlow, AnomalyCard, FounderProfile, _generate_anomaly_id, _now_iso
11	
12	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
13	
14	
15	class AnomalyCrossReferencer:
16	    def __init__(self, historical: Optional[list[AnomalyCard]] = None):
17	        self.historical = historical or []
18	
19	    def cross_reference(
20	        self,
21	        deltas: list[PriceDelta],
22	        flows: list[ForcedFlow],
23	        founder: Optional[FounderProfile] = None,
24	    ) -> list[AnomalyCard]:
25	        cards: list[AnomalyCard] = []
26	
27	        for delta in deltas:
28	            for flow in flows:
29	                if self._rule_forced_creates_delta(delta, flow):
30	                    card = self._build_intersection_card(delta, flow, founder, "RULE_1_FORCED_CREATES_DELTA")
31	                    cards.append(card)
32	
33	        for delta in deltas:
34	            if founder and self._rule_delta_founder_access(delta, founder) > 0.3:
35	                if not any(c.delta and c.delta.get("product") == delta.product
36	                           and c.intersection_rule == "RULE_1_FORCED_CREATES_DELTA" for c in cards):
37	                    card = self._build_delta_card(delta, founder, "RULE_2_DELTA_FOUNDER_ACCESS")
38	                    cards.append(card)
39	
40	        for flow in flows:
41	            if founder and self._rule_flow_founder_expertise(flow, founder) > 0.3:
42	                if not any(c.flow and c.flow.get("regulation") == flow.regulation
43	                           and c.intersection_rule == "RULE_1_FORCED_CREATES_DELTA" for c in cards):
44	                    card = self._build_flow_card(flow, founder, "RULE_3_FLOW_FOUNDER_EXPERTISE")
45	                    cards.append(card)
46	
47	        for card in cards:
48	            hist_boost = self._rule_historical_persistence(card)
49	            if hist_boost > 0:
50	                card.anomaly_score = min(1.0, card.anomaly_score + hist_boost)
51	                card.delta_trend = self._get_historical_trend(card)
52	
53	        convergence_boost = self._rule_convergence(cards)
54	        for card in cards:
55	            key = card.delta.get("product", "") if card.delta else card.flow.get("regulation", "") if card.flow else ""
56	            if key in convergence_boost:
57	                card.anomaly_score = min(1.0, card.anomaly_score + convergence_boost[key])
58	
59	        for card in cards:
60	            self._score_card(card, founder)
61	            self._generate_contacts(card)
62	            self._set_kill_criteria(card)
63	
64	        cards.sort(key=lambda c: c.final_rank(), reverse=True)
65	        logger.info(f"Cross-referenced {len(deltas)} deltas × {len(flows)} flows → {len(cards)} anomaly cards")
66	        return cards
67	
68	    def _rule_forced_creates_delta(self, delta: PriceDelta, flow: ForcedFlow) -> bool:
69	        delta_markets = {delta.market_a.lower(), delta.market_b.lower()}
70	        flow_jurisdiction = flow.jurisdiction.lower()
71	        geo_match = any(flow_jurisdiction in m or m in flow_jurisdiction for m in delta_markets)
72	        product_lower = delta.product.lower()
73	        comply_lower = flow.who_must_comply.lower()
74	        reg_lower = flow.regulation.lower()
75	        flow_text = f"{comply_lower} {reg_lower}"
76	        industry_match = (product_lower in flow_text or any(
77	            w in flow_text for w in product_lower.split()
78	        ))
79	        product_industry_map = {
80	            "coffee": ["agriculture", "agri", "import", "export", "commodity", "food", "deforestation", "eudr"],
81	            "pepper": ["agriculture", "agri", "import", "export", "spice", "food", "eudr"],
82	            "robusta": ["coffee", "agriculture", "import", "export", "commodity", "eudr"],
83	            "cashew": ["agriculture", "import", "export", "food", "nut", "eudr"],
84	            "cinnamon": ["agriculture", "import", "export", "spice"],
85	            "commodity": ["trade", "import", "export", "agriculture"],
86	        }
87	        for key, related in product_industry_map.items():
88	            if key in product_lower and any(r in flow_text for r in related):
89	                industry_match = True
90	                break
91	        return geo_match or industry_match
92	
93	    def _rule_delta_founder_access(self, delta: PriceDelta, founder: FounderProfile) -> float:
94	        score = 0.0
95	        location_lower = founder.location.lower() if founder.location else ""
96	        if location_lower:
97	            if location_lower in delta.market_a.lower() or delta.market_a.lower() in location_lower:
98	                score += 0.4
99	        for lang in founder.languages:
100	            lang_lower = lang.lower()
101	            market_lang_map = {
102	                "vietnamese": ["vietnam", "vn"],
103	                "vi": ["vietnam", "vn"],
104	                "english": ["us", "uk", "australia", "eu"],
105	                "en": ["us", "uk", "australia", "eu"],
106	                "mandarin": ["china", "cn"],
107	                "chinese": ["china", "cn"],
108	                "japanese": ["japan", "jp"],
109	                "ja": ["japan", "jp"],
110	            }
111	            market_keys = market_lang_map.get(lang_lower, [])
112	            for key in market_keys:
113	                if key in delta.market_a.lower() or key in delta.market_b.lower():
114	                    score += 0.3
115	                    break
116	        if founder.has_industry(delta.product):
117	            score += 0.3
118	        return min(1.0, score)
119	
120	    def _rule_flow_founder_expertise(self, flow: ForcedFlow, founder: FounderProfile) -> float:
121	        score = 0.0
122	        flow_text = f"{flow.regulation} {flow.who_must_comply} {flow.provider_gap}".lower()
123	        flow_words = set(flow_text.split())
124	        for expertise in founder.domain_expertise:
125	            exp_words = set(expertise.lower().split())
126	            if exp_words & flow_words:
127	                score += 0.4
128	                break
129	        for industry in founder.industries:
130	            ind_words = set(industry.lower().split())
131	            if ind_words & flow_words:
132	                score += 0.3
133	                break
134	        location_lower = founder.location.lower() if founder.location else ""
135	        jurisdiction_lower = flow.jurisdiction.lower()
136	        if location_lower and (jurisdiction_lower in location_lower
137	                               or any(w in location_lower for w in jurisdiction_lower.split())):
138	            score += 0.3
139	        return min(1.0, score)
140	
141	    def _rule_historical_persistence(self, card: AnomalyCard) -> float:
142	        if not self.historical:
143	            return 0.0
144	        for hist in self.historical:
145	            if card.delta and hist.delta:
146	                if (card.delta.get("product") == hist.delta.get("product") and
147	                    card.delta.get("market_a") == hist.delta.get("market_a")):
148	                    if hist.delta_trend != "SHRINKING":
149	                        return 0.15
150	            if card.flow and hist.flow:
151	                if card.flow.get("regulation") == hist.flow.get("regulation"):
152	                    return 0.1
153	        return 0.0
154	
155	    def _get_historical_trend(self, card: AnomalyCard) -> str:
156	        for hist in self.historical:
157	            if card.delta and hist.delta:

629	def run_hunt(
630	    seed_products: Optional[list[str]] = None,
631	    markets: Optional[list[str]] = None,
632	    geographies: Optional[list[str]] = None,
633	    industries: Optional[list[str]] = None,
634	    founder_path: Optional[str] = None,
635	    db_path: Optional[str] = None,
636	    max_brain1_calls: int = 30,
637	    max_brain2_calls: int = 30,
638	    llm_model: str = "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
639	) -> dict:
640	    """Run the full V5 hunt pipeline with real DuckDuckGo + Claude API.
641	
642	    Returns dict with keys: cards, deltas, flows, graph_stats, budget.
643	    """
644	    founder = load_founder_profile(founder_path)
645	    llm_fn = _create_llm_fn(llm_model)
646	
647	    # Step 0: Build IC for hypothesis-guided search
648	    ic = IntelligenceController(
649	        research_fn=_ddg_research,
650	        llm_fn=llm_fn,
651	    )
652	
653	    # Step 1: IC generates hypotheses BEFORE data collection
654	    hypotheses = []
655	    targeted_price_queries = []
656	    targeted_flow_queries = []
657	    try:
658	        seeds = {
659	            "products": seed_products or [],
660	            "markets": markets or [],
661	            "geographies": geographies or [],
662	            "industries": industries or [],
663	            "founder": founder.to_dict() if hasattr(founder, "to_dict") else {},
664	        }
665	        logger.info("=== IC: Hypothesis Generation (pre-search) ===")
666	        hypotheses = ic.generate_hypotheses(seeds, llm_fn)
667	        logger.info(f"IC generated {len(hypotheses)} hypotheses")
668	        for h in hypotheses:
669	            targeted_price_queries.extend(h.get("search_queries", []))
670	            targeted_flow_queries.extend(h.get("flow_queries", []))
671	    except Exception as e:
672	        logger.warning(f"IC hypothesis generation failed ({e}), falling back to broad scan")
673	        hypotheses = []
674	
675	    # Step 2: Price Delta Engine — hypothesis-guided + broad scan
676	    ic_guided = len(targeted_price_queries) > 0
677	    brain1_budget = max_brain1_calls
678	    if ic_guided:
679	        brain1_budget = max(15, max_brain1_calls - len(targeted_price_queries))
680	
681	    logger.info("=== BRAIN 1: Price Delta Engine ===")
682	    engine1 = PriceDeltaEngine(
683	        _ddg_research, llm_fn,
684	        max_calls=brain1_budget, spread_threshold=30.0,
685	    )
686	    deltas = engine1.scan(
687	        seed_products=seed_products,
688	        markets=markets,
689	        founder=founder,
690	        targeted_queries=targeted_price_queries if ic_guided else None,
691	    )
692	    logger.info(f"Brain 1 found {len(deltas)} price deltas "
693	                f"(used {engine1.budget.calls_used}/{engine1.budget.max_calls})"
694	                f"{' [IC-guided]' if ic_guided else ''}")
695	
696	    # Step 3: Forced Flow Engine — hypothesis-guided + broad scan
697	    brain2_budget = max_brain2_calls
698	    if targeted_flow_queries:
699	        brain2_budget = max(15, max_brain2_calls - len(targeted_flow_queries))
700	
701	    logger.info("=== BRAIN 2: Forced Flow Engine ===")
702	    engine2 = ForcedFlowEngine(
703	        _ddg_research, llm_fn,
704	        max_calls=brain2_budget,
705	    )
706	    flows = engine2.scan(
707	        geographies=geographies,
708	        industries=industries,
709	        founder=founder,
710	        targeted_queries=targeted_flow_queries if targeted_flow_queries else None,
711	    )
712	    logger.info(f"Brain 2 found {len(flows)} forced flows "
713	                f"(used {engine2.budget.calls_used}/{engine2.budget.max_calls})"
714	                f"{' [IC-guided]' if targeted_flow_queries else ''}")
715	
716	    # Step 4: Update IC graph with real data
717	    logger.info("=== GRAPH: Anomaly Overlay + IC Update ===")
718	    graph = ic.graph
719	    graph.add_anomaly_overlay(
720	        [d.to_dict() for d in deltas],
721	        [f.to_dict() for f in flows],
722	    )
723	    if hypotheses:
724	        try:
725	            ic.update_from_results(
726	                [d.to_dict() for d in deltas],
727	                [f.to_dict() for f in flows],
728	            )
729	            ic.judge_hypotheses()
730	            logger.info(f"IC judged {len(hypotheses)} hypotheses against data")
731	        except Exception as e:
732	            logger.warning(f"IC update/judge failed ({e}), continuing without")
733	
734	    graph_stats = graph.to_dict()["stats"]
735	
736	    # Step 5: Anomaly Cross-Reference
737	    logger.info("=== BRAIN 3: Anomaly Cross-Reference ===")
738	    store_path = db_path or str(DEFAULT_DB_PATH)
739	    store = AnomalyStore(store_path)
740	    historical = store.load_active_cards()
741	
742	    xref = AnomalyCrossReferencer(historical=historical)
743	    cards = xref.cross_reference(deltas, flows, founder)
744	
745	    # Step 6: Persist
746	    logger.info("=== PERSIST ===")
747	    for card in cards:
748	        store.save_card(card)
749	        delta_pct = card.delta.get("spread_pct", 0.0) if card.delta else 0.0
750	        store.record_history(
751	            card.id, card.anomaly_score,
752	            card.monthly_income, delta_pct,
753	        )
754	
755	    budget_summary = {
756	        "brain1_used": engine1.budget.calls_used,
757	        "brain1_max": engine1.budget.max_calls,
758	        "brain2_used": engine2.budget.calls_used,
759	        "brain2_max": engine2.budget.max_calls,

763	        "total_max": engine1.budget.max_calls + engine2.budget.max_calls,
764	    }
765	
766	    store.close()
767	
768	    return {
769	        "cards": cards,
770	        "deltas": deltas,
771	        "flows": flows,
772	        "graph_stats": graph_stats,
773	        "hypotheses": hypotheses,
774	        "budget": budget_summary,
775	        "founder": founder,
776	    }

"""Tests for brains/models.py — serialization, validation, computed fields."""

import pytest
from ..models import PriceDelta, ForcedFlow, AnomalyCard, FounderProfile


class TestPriceDelta:
    def test_spread_auto_calculated(self):
        d = PriceDelta(product="coffee", market_a="VN", market_b="EU",
                       price_a=1000, price_b=1500, currency="USD", unit="ton")
        assert d.spread_pct == pytest.approx(50.0)

    def test_net_margin_auto_calculated(self):
        d = PriceDelta(product="coffee", market_a="VN", market_b="EU",
                       price_a=1000, price_b=1500, currency="USD", unit="ton",
                       bridge_cost=200)
        assert d.net_margin == pytest.approx(300.0)
        assert d.net_margin_pct == pytest.approx(30.0)

    def test_round_trip(self):
        d = PriceDelta(product="pepper", market_a="VN", market_b="US",
                       price_a=5000, price_b=8000, currency="USD", unit="ton",
                       bridge_cost=500, sources=["http://example.com"])
        restored = PriceDelta.from_dict(d.to_dict())
        assert restored.product == "pepper"
        assert restored.spread_pct == d.spread_pct
        assert restored.net_margin == d.net_margin
        assert restored.sources == ["http://example.com"]

    def test_zero_price_a_no_division_error(self):
        d = PriceDelta(product="x", market_a="A", market_b="B",
                       price_a=0, price_b=100, currency="USD", unit="kg")
        assert d.spread_pct == 0.0


class TestForcedFlow:
    def test_total_spend_auto_calculated(self):
        f = ForcedFlow(regulation="EU AI Act", jurisdiction="EU",
                       effective_date="2026-08-01", who_must_comply="AI deployers",
                       entity_count=15000, compliance_cost=50000)
        assert f.total_forced_spend == pytest.approx(750_000_000)

    def test_urgency_score(self):
        f = ForcedFlow(regulation="test", jurisdiction="US",
                       effective_date="2026-12-01", who_must_comply="all",
                       deadline_urgency=100)
        score = f.urgency_score()
        assert 0 < score < 1
        assert score == pytest.approx((365 - 100) / 365)

    def test_urgency_score_past_deadline(self):
        f = ForcedFlow(regulation="test", jurisdiction="US",
                       effective_date="2025-01-01", who_must_comply="all",
                       deadline_urgency=400)
        assert f.urgency_score() == 0.0

    def test_priority_score_with_gap(self):
        f = ForcedFlow(regulation="EUDR", jurisdiction="EU",
                       effective_date="2026-12-30", who_must_comply="importers",
                       entity_count=10000, compliance_cost=10000,
                       deadline_urgency=180, provider_gap="no VN traceability")
        score = f.priority_score()
        assert 0 < score <= 1.0

    def test_round_trip(self):
        f = ForcedFlow(regulation="Circular 78", jurisdiction="VN",
                       effective_date="2026-07-01", who_must_comply="enterprises",
                       entity_count=5000, compliance_cost=1000,
                       provider_gap="missing digital filing", sources=["http://gov.vn"])
        restored = ForcedFlow.from_dict(f.to_dict())
        assert restored.regulation == "Circular 78"
        assert restored.total_forced_spend == f.total_forced_spend


class TestAnomalyCard:
    def test_id_format(self):
        c = AnomalyCard()
        assert c.id.startswith("ANOM-")
        parts = c.id.split("-")
        assert len(parts) == 4  # ANOM-YYMMDD-HHMMSS-hexsuffix
        assert len(parts[1]) == 6
        assert len(parts[2]) == 6
        assert len(parts[3]) == 6

    def test_margin_auto_calculated(self):
        c = AnomalyCard(price_per_unit=100, cost_per_unit=30, units_per_month=50)
        assert c.margin_per_unit == pytest.approx(70.0)
        assert c.monthly_income == pytest.approx(3500.0)

    def test_final_rank(self):
        c = AnomalyCard(anomaly_score=0.8, margin_per_unit=500,
                        founder_fit=0.7, urgency=0.9)
        rank = c.final_rank()
        assert rank > 0
        expected = 0.8 * (500 / 1000) * 0.7 * 0.9
        assert rank == pytest.approx(expected)

    def test_final_rank_zero_urgency(self):
        c = AnomalyCard(anomaly_score=0.8, margin_per_unit=500,
                        founder_fit=0.7, urgency=0.0)
        rank = c.final_rank()
        assert rank > 0  # uses 0.01 floor

    def test_round_trip(self):
        c = AnomalyCard(
            anomaly_type="INTERSECTION", title="test anomaly",
            position_type="BROKER", action="CONNECT",
            price_per_unit=100, cost_per_unit=30, units_per_month=50,
            contacts=[{"name": "test", "role": "buyer"}],
            script="Hi, I noticed...", kill_criteria="No response in 7 days"
        )
        restored = AnomalyCard.from_dict(c.to_dict())
        assert restored.anomaly_type == "INTERSECTION"
        assert restored.monthly_income == c.monthly_income
        assert len(restored.contacts) == 1

    def test_default_status(self):
        c = AnomalyCard()
        assert c.status == "ACTIVE"
        assert c.delta_trend == "STABLE"


class TestFounderProfile:
    def test_has_language(self):
        f = FounderProfile(languages=["Vietnamese", "English", "Mandarin"])
        assert f.has_language("vietnamese")
        assert f.has_language("ENGLISH")
        assert not f.has_language("Portuguese")

    def test_has_industry(self):
        f = FounderProfile(industries=["coffee export", "agriculture"])
        assert f.has_industry("coffee")
        assert f.has_industry("Agriculture")
        assert not f.has_industry("fintech")

    def test_has_expertise(self):
        f = FounderProfile(domain_expertise=["commodity trading", "VN tax"])
        assert f.has_expertise("commodity")
        assert f.has_expertise("tax")
        assert not f.has_expertise("AI")

    def test_round_trip(self):
        f = FounderProfile(
            industries=["coffee"], languages=["vi", "en"],
            location="Dak Lak, VN", capital_range="$5K-$20K"
        )
        restored = FounderProfile.from_dict(f.to_dict())
        assert restored.location == "Dak Lak, VN"
        assert restored.capital_range == "$5K-$20K"

        pos_market = position.market.lower()

    def _rule_position_captures_forced_flow(self, position: FlowPosition, flow: ForcedFlow) -> bool:
        pos_market = position.market.lower()
        jurisdiction = flow.jurisdiction.lower()
        geo_match = pos_market in jurisdiction or jurisdiction in pos_market

            (position.position_type == "STANDARD" and "compliance" in flow.regulation.lower())
            or (position.position_type == "BOTTLENECK" and flow.provider_gap)
            or (position.position_type == "GATEWAY" and flow.entity_count > 1000)

"""Tests for Brain 4: Flow Position Engine."""

import json
import pytest
from ..flow_position_engine import FlowPositionEngine, KEYWORD_CLUSTERS
from ..models import FlowPosition, FounderProfile


def _mock_research(text: str):
    def fn(query: str) -> str:
        return text
    return fn


def _mock_llm(positions: list[dict]):
    def fn(prompt: str) -> str:
        return json.dumps(positions)
    return fn


class TestFlowPositionEngineScan:
    def test_scan_returns_flow_positions(self):
        research = _mock_research(
            "OpenRouter API gateway marketplace platform handles 5000 transactions per day "
            "with 3% commission fee. 5 competitors in market."
        )
        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=research)
        positions = engine.scan("AI API")
        assert len(positions) > 0
        assert all(isinstance(p, FlowPosition) for p in positions)

    def test_scan_with_llm_fn(self):
        research = _mock_research("some text about platforms")
        llm = _mock_llm([{
            "flow_name": "AI API Gateway",
            "position_type": "GATEWAY",
            "market": "global",
            "description": "Routes AI requests",
            "estimated_daily_volume": 50000,
            "take_rate": 0.03,
            "avg_transaction_value": 0.10,
            "switching_cost": 0.6,
            "alternative_count": 3,
            "network_effect": 0.4,
            "build_complexity": 0.5,
            "capital_required": 10000,
            "time_to_first_flow": 30,
        }])
        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=research, llm_fn=llm)
        positions = engine.scan("AI API")
        assert len(positions) == 1
        assert positions[0].flow_name == "AI API Gateway"
        assert positions[0].position_type == "GATEWAY"
        assert positions[0].estimated_daily_volume == 50000

    def test_scan_heuristic_fallback(self):
        research = _mock_research(
            "This marketplace aggregator platform connects 1000 transactions per day "
            "at a 5% commission take rate. A hub and exchange for services."
        )
        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=research, llm_fn=None)
        positions = engine.scan("freelance services")
        assert len(positions) > 0
        assert any(p.position_type == "AGGREGATOR" for p in positions)

    def test_scan_empty_results(self):
        research = _mock_research("")
        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=research)
        positions = engine.scan("obscure topic xyz")
        assert positions == []

    def test_founder_fit_scoring(self):
        research = _mock_research(
            "API gateway marketplace platform with 2000 requests per day "
            "and 4% commission fee. Analytics data intelligence tracking."
        )
        founder = FounderProfile(
            industries=["technology"], languages=["English"],
            location="Vietnam", domain_expertise=["API development"]
        )
        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=research)
        positions = engine.scan("API services", founder=founder)
        assert len(positions) > 0

    def test_budget_enforcement(self):
        call_count = 0

        def counting_research(query: str) -> str:
            nonlocal call_count
            call_count += 1
            return "marketplace platform aggregator hub"

        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=counting_research, max_calls=2)
        engine.scan("test topic")
        assert call_count <= 2

    def test_llm_extraction_invalid_json_falls_back(self):
        research = _mock_research(
            "gateway platform API marketplace aggregator hub exchange "
            "5000 requests per day with 3% commission fee"
        )

        def bad_llm(prompt: str) -> str:
            return "not valid json at all"

        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=research, llm_fn=bad_llm)
        positions = engine.scan("test")
        assert isinstance(positions, list)


class TestHeuristicExtraction:
    def test_volume_extraction(self):
        research = _mock_research("handles 5000 transactions per day across the platform")
        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=research)
        vol = engine._extract_volume("handles 5000 transactions per day across the platform")
        assert vol == 5000.0

    def test_take_rate_extraction(self):
        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=_mock_research(""))
        rate = engine._extract_take_rate("charges a 2.5% commission on each transaction")
        assert rate == pytest.approx(0.025)

    def test_alternative_count_extraction(self):
        engine = FlowPositionEngine(research_fn=_mock_research(""))
        count = engine._extract_alternative_count("there are 8 competitors in this space")
        assert count == 8

class TestPriceDelta:
    def test_spread_auto_calculated(self):
        d = PriceDelta(product="coffee", market_a="VN", market_b="EU",
                       price_a=1000, price_b=1500, currency="USD", unit="ton")
        assert d.spread_pct == pytest.approx(50.0)

    def test_net_margin_auto_calculated(self):
        d = PriceDelta(product="coffee", market_a="VN", market_b="EU",
                       price_a=1000, price_b=1500, currency="USD", unit="ton",
                       bridge_cost=200)
        assert d.net_margin == pytest.approx(300.0)
        assert d.net_margin_pct == pytest.approx(30.0)

    def test_round_trip(self):
        d = PriceDelta(product="pepper", market_a="VN", market_b="US",
                       price_a=5000, price_b=8000, currency="USD", unit="ton",
                       bridge_cost=500, sources=["http://example.com"])
        restored = PriceDelta.from_dict(d.to_dict())
        assert restored.product == "pepper"
        assert restored.spread_pct == d.spread_pct
        assert restored.net_margin == d.net_margin
        assert restored.sources == ["http://example.com"]

    def test_zero_price_a_no_division_error(self):
        d = PriceDelta(product="x", market_a="A", market_b="B",
                       price_a=0, price_b=100, currency="USD", unit="kg")
        assert d.spread_pct == 0.0

                       entity_count=15000, compliance_cost=50000)

                       effective_date="2025-01-01", who_must_comply="all",

class TestThreeBrainCrossRef:
    def test_crossref_with_positions_backward_compat(self):
        xref = AnomalyCrossReferencer()
        founder = _make_founder()
        cards_no_pos = xref.cross_reference([_make_delta()], [_make_flow()], founder)
        xref2 = AnomalyCrossReferencer()
        cards_with_pos = xref2.cross_reference([_make_delta()], [_make_flow()], founder, positions=None)
        assert len(cards_no_pos) == len(cards_with_pos)

    def test_rule4_position_amplifies_delta(self):
        xref = AnomalyCrossReferencer()
        delta = _make_delta(market_a="Vietnam", market_b="EU")
        position = _make_position(market="Vietnam")
        cards = xref.cross_reference([delta], [], _make_founder(), positions=[position])
        rule4_cards = [c for c in cards if c.intersection_rule == "RULE_4_POSITION_AMPLIFIES_DELTA"]
        assert len(rule4_cards) >= 1
        assert rule4_cards[0].anomaly_type == "FLOW_POSITION"

    def test_rule5_position_captures_forced_flow(self):
        xref = AnomalyCrossReferencer()
        flow = _make_flow(jurisdiction="EU", entity_count=5000, provider_gap="no solution")
        position = _make_position(market="EU", position_type="BOTTLENECK")
        cards = xref.cross_reference([], [flow], _make_founder(), positions=[position])
        rule5_cards = [c for c in cards if c.intersection_rule == "RULE_5_POSITION_CAPTURES_FLOW"]
        assert len(rule5_cards) >= 1

    def test_rule6_standalone_position(self):
        xref = AnomalyCrossReferencer()
        position = _make_position(switching_cost=0.9, alternative_count=1, network_effect=0.8)
        assert position.position_score() > 0.5
        cards = xref.cross_reference([], [], _make_founder(), positions=[position])
        rule6_cards = [c for c in cards if c.intersection_rule == "RULE_6_STANDALONE_POSITION"]
        assert len(rule6_cards) == 1

    def test_flow_position_card_has_correct_type(self):
        xref = AnomalyCrossReferencer()
        position = _make_position(switching_cost=0.9, alternative_count=1, network_effect=0.8)
        cards = xref.cross_reference([], [], _make_founder(), positions=[position])
        fp_cards = [c for c in cards if c.anomaly_type == "FLOW_POSITION"]
        assert len(fp_cards) >= 1
        assert fp_cards[0].flow_position is not None
        assert fp_cards[0].flow_position["flow_name"] == "VN API Gateway"

    def test_position_card_action_build_vs_acquire(self):
        xref = AnomalyCrossReferencer()
        simple = _make_position(build_complexity=0.3, switching_cost=0.9, alternative_count=1, network_effect=0.8)
        hard = _make_position(flow_name="Hard Position", build_complexity=0.8,
                              switching_cost=0.9, alternative_count=1, network_effect=0.8)
        cards = xref.cross_reference([], [], _make_founder(), positions=[simple, hard])
        actions = {c.flow_position["flow_name"]: c.action for c in cards if c.flow_position}
        assert actions.get("VN API Gateway") == "BUILD"
        assert actions.get("Hard Position") == "ACQUIRE"

1	"""
2	Brain 3: Anomaly Cross-Reference Engine.
3	Triangulates Brain 1 (price deltas) + Brain 2 (forced flows) + founder profile
4	+ historical anomalies → ranked AnomalyCards. No web calls — pure computation.
5	"""
6	
7	import logging
8	from typing import Optional
9	
10	from .models import PriceDelta, ForcedFlow, FlowPosition, AnomalyCard, FounderProfile, _generate_anomaly_id, _now_iso
11	
12	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
13	
14	
15	class AnomalyCrossReferencer:
16	    def __init__(self, historical: Optional[list[AnomalyCard]] = None):
17	        self.historical = historical or []
18	
19	    def cross_reference(
20	        self,
21	        deltas: list[PriceDelta],
22	        flows: list[ForcedFlow],
23	        founder: Optional[FounderProfile] = None,
24	        positions: Optional[list[FlowPosition]] = None,
25	    ) -> list[AnomalyCard]:
26	        cards: list[AnomalyCard] = []
27	
28	        for delta in deltas:
29	            for flow in flows:
30	                if self._rule_forced_creates_delta(delta, flow):
31	                    card = self._build_intersection_card(delta, flow, founder, "RULE_1_FORCED_CREATES_DELTA")
32	                    cards.append(card)
33	
34	        for delta in deltas:
35	            if founder and self._rule_delta_founder_access(delta, founder) > 0.3:
36	                if not any(c.delta and c.delta.get("product") == delta.product
37	                           and c.intersection_rule == "RULE_1_FORCED_CREATES_DELTA" for c in cards):
38	                    card = self._build_delta_card(delta, founder, "RULE_2_DELTA_FOUNDER_ACCESS")
39	                    cards.append(card)
40	
41	        for flow in flows:
42	            if founder and self._rule_flow_founder_expertise(flow, founder) > 0.3:
43	                if not any(c.flow and c.flow.get("regulation") == flow.regulation
44	                           and c.intersection_rule == "RULE_1_FORCED_CREATES_DELTA" for c in cards):
45	                    card = self._build_flow_card(flow, founder, "RULE_3_FLOW_FOUNDER_EXPERTISE")
46	                    cards.append(card)
47	
48	        if positions:
49	            for position in positions:
50	                for delta in deltas:
51	                    if self._rule_position_amplifies_delta(position, delta):
52	                        card = self._build_position_card(position, founder, "RULE_4_POSITION_AMPLIFIES_DELTA")
53	                        card.delta = delta.to_dict()
54	                        cards.append(card)
55	                        break
56	
57	                for flow in flows:
58	                    if self._rule_position_captures_forced_flow(position, flow):
59	                        card = self._build_position_card(position, founder, "RULE_5_POSITION_CAPTURES_FLOW")
60	                        card.flow = flow.to_dict()
61	                        cards.append(card)
62	                        break
63	
64	                if position.position_score() > 0.5:
65	                    already_added = any(
66	                        c.flow_position and c.flow_position.get("flow_name") == position.flow_name
67	                        for c in cards
68	                    )
69	                    if not already_added:
70	                        card = self._build_position_card(position, founder, "RULE_6_STANDALONE_POSITION")
71	                        cards.append(card)
72	
73	        for card in cards:
74	            hist_boost = self._rule_historical_persistence(card)
75	            if hist_boost > 0:
76	                card.anomaly_score = min(1.0, card.anomaly_score + hist_boost)
77	                card.delta_trend = self._get_historical_trend(card)
78	
79	        convergence_boost = self._rule_convergence(cards)
80	        for card in cards:
81	            key = card.delta.get("product", "") if card.delta else card.flow.get("regulation", "") if card.flow else ""
82	            if key in convergence_boost:
83	                card.anomaly_score = min(1.0, card.anomaly_score + convergence_boost[key])
84	
85	        for card in cards:
86	            self._score_card(card, founder)
87	            self._generate_contacts(card)
88	            self._set_kill_criteria(card)
89	
90	        cards.sort(key=lambda c: c.final_rank(), reverse=True)
91	        logger.info(f"Cross-referenced {len(deltas)} deltas × {len(flows)} flows → {len(cards)} anomaly cards")
92	        return cards
93	
94	    def _rule_forced_creates_delta(self, delta: PriceDelta, flow: ForcedFlow) -> bool:
95	        delta_markets = {delta.market_a.lower(), delta.market_b.lower()}
96	        flow_jurisdiction = flow.jurisdiction.lower()
97	        geo_match = any(flow_jurisdiction in m or m in flow_jurisdiction for m in delta_markets)
98	        product_lower = delta.product.lower()
99	        comply_lower = flow.who_must_comply.lower()
100	        reg_lower = flow.regulation.lower()
101	        flow_text = f"{comply_lower} {reg_lower}"
102	        industry_match = (product_lower in flow_text or any(
103	            w in flow_text for w in product_lower.split()
104	        ))
105	        product_industry_map = {
106	            "coffee": ["agriculture", "agri", "import", "export", "commodity", "food", "deforestation", "eudr"],
107	            "pepper": ["agriculture", "agri", "import", "export", "spice", "food", "eudr"],
108	            "robusta": ["coffee", "agriculture", "import", "export", "commodity", "eudr"],
109	            "cashew": ["agriculture", "import", "export", "food", "nut", "eudr"],
110	            "cinnamon": ["agriculture", "import", "export", "spice"],
111	            "commodity": ["trade", "import", "export", "agriculture"],
112	        }
113	        for key, related in product_industry_map.items():
114	            if key in product_lower and any(r in flow_text for r in related):
115	                industry_match = True
116	                break
117	        return geo_match or industry_match
118	
119	    def _rule_delta_founder_access(self, delta: PriceDelta, founder: FounderProfile) -> float:
120	        score = 0.0
121	        location_lower = founder.location.lower() if founder.location else ""
122	        if location_lower:
123	            if location_lower in delta.market_a.lower() or delta.market_a.lower() in location_lower:
124	                score += 0.4
125	        for lang in founder.languages:
126	            lang_lower = lang.lower()
127	            market_lang_map = {
128	                "vietnamese": ["vietnam", "vn"],
129	                "vi": ["vietnam", "vn"],
130	                "english": ["us", "uk", "australia", "eu"],
131	                "en": ["us", "uk", "australia", "eu"],
132	                "mandarin": ["china", "cn"],
133	                "chinese": ["china", "cn"],
134	                "japanese": ["japan", "jp"],
135	                "ja": ["japan", "jp"],
136	            }
137	            market_keys = market_lang_map.get(lang_lower, [])
138	            for key in market_keys:
139	                if key in delta.market_a.lower() or key in delta.market_b.lower():
140	                    score += 0.3
141	                    break
142	        if founder.has_industry(delta.product):
143	            score += 0.3
144	        return min(1.0, score)
145	
146	    def _rule_flow_founder_expertise(self, flow: ForcedFlow, founder: FounderProfile) -> float:
147	        score = 0.0
148	        flow_text = f"{flow.regulation} {flow.who_must_comply} {flow.provider_gap}".lower()
149	        flow_words = set(flow_text.split())
150	        for expertise in founder.domain_expertise:
151	            exp_words = set(expertise.lower().split())
152	            if exp_words & flow_words:
153	                score += 0.4
154	                break
155	        for industry in founder.industries:
156	            ind_words = set(industry.lower().split())
157	            if ind_words & flow_words:
158	                score += 0.3
159	                break
160	        location_lower = founder.location.lower() if founder.location else ""
161	        jurisdiction_lower = flow.jurisdiction.lower()
162	        if location_lower and (jurisdiction_lower in location_lower
163	                               or any(w in location_lower for w in jurisdiction_lower.split())):
164	            score += 0.3
165	        return min(1.0, score)
166	
167	    def _rule_historical_persistence(self, card: AnomalyCard) -> float:
168	        if not self.historical:
169	            return 0.0
170	        for hist in self.historical:
171	            if card.delta and hist.delta:
172	                if (card.delta.get("product") == hist.delta.get("product") and
173	                    card.delta.get("market_a") == hist.delta.get("market_a")):
174	                    if hist.delta_trend != "SHRINKING":
175	                        return 0.15
176	            if card.flow and hist.flow:
177	                if card.flow.get("regulation") == hist.flow.get("regulation"):
178	                    return 0.1
179	        return 0.0
180	
181	    def _get_historical_trend(self, card: AnomalyCard) -> str:
182	        for hist in self.historical:
183	            if card.delta and hist.delta:
184	                if card.delta.get("product") == hist.delta.get("product"):
185	                    return hist.delta_trend
186	        return "STABLE"
187	
188	    def _rule_convergence(self, cards: list[AnomalyCard]) -> dict[str, float]:
189	        signal_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
190	        for card in cards:
191	            keys = []
192	            if card.delta:
193	                keys.append(card.delta.get("product", ""))
194	            if card.flow:
195	                keys.append(card.flow.get("regulation", ""))
196	            for k in keys:

2	Brain 4: Flow Position Engine.
3	Identifies toll/owner positions (GATEWAY, AGGREGATOR, STANDARD, BOTTLENECK, DATA_EXHAUST)
4	in money flows. Python controls search templates, LLM enriches if available.
5	"""

7	import json
8	import logging
9	import re
10	from typing import Callable, Optional
11	
12	from .models import FlowPosition, FounderProfile, VALID_POSITION_TYPES
13	
14	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

18	    '"{topic}" toll position intermediary aggregator commission',
19	    '"{topic}" infrastructure provider bottleneck monopoly',
20	]
21	
22	POSITION_EXTRACTION_PROMPT = """Analyze this text about "{topic}" and identify toll/owner positions in the money flow.
23	For each position found, return JSON array:
24	[{{"flow_name": "...", "position_type": "GATEWAY|AGGREGATOR|STANDARD|BOTTLENECK|DATA_EXHAUST",
25	"market": "...", "description": "...",
26	"estimated_daily_volume": <number or 0>, "take_rate": <decimal 0-1>,
27	"avg_transaction_value": <number or 0>,
28	"switching_cost": <0-1>, "alternative_count": <int>,
29	"network_effect": <0-1>, "build_complexity": <0-1>,
30	"capital_required": <number>, "time_to_first_flow": <days>}}]
31	
32	Position types:
33	- GATEWAY: sits between all traffic (API gateways, payment processors)
34	- AGGREGATOR: combines many small suppliers for buyers (marketplaces)
35	- STANDARD: defines the protocol others must follow (certifications)
36	- BOTTLENECK: only path through which flow must pass (regulatory)
37	- DATA_EXHAUST: captures data from flow as byproduct (analytics)
38	
39	If no positions found, return [].
40	
41	Text:
42	{text}"""
43	
44	KEYWORD_CLUSTERS = {
45	    "GATEWAY": ["api", "gateway", "payment", "processor", "routing", "proxy", "middleware"],
46	    "AGGREGATOR": ["marketplace", "aggregator", "platform", "exchange", "directory", "hub"],
47	    "STANDARD": ["certification", "standard", "protocol", "compliance", "accreditation"],
48	    "BOTTLENECK": ["monopoly", "sole provider", "only", "required", "mandatory", "bottleneck"],
49	    "DATA_EXHAUST": ["analytics", "data", "insights", "tracking", "monitoring", "intelligence"],
50	}
51	
52	VOLUME_PATTERNS = [
53	    (r'([\d,.]+)\s*(?:million|M)\s*(?:transactions?|requests?|users?|calls?)', 1_000_000),
54	    (r'([\d,.]+)\s*(?:thousand|K)\s*(?:transactions?|requests?|users?|calls?)', 1_000),
55	    (r'([\d,.]+)\s*(?:transactions?|requests?|calls?)\s*(?:per|/)\s*(?:day|daily)', 1),
56	    (r'([\d,.]+)\s*(?:transactions?|requests?|calls?)\s*(?:per|/)\s*(?:month|monthly)', 1/30),
57	]
58	
59	TAKE_RATE_PATTERNS = [
60	    r'([\d.]+)\s*%\s*(?:commission|take\s*rate|fee|cut|margin)',
61	    r'(?:commission|take\s*rate|fee|cut)\s*(?:of|:)?\s*([\d.]+)\s*%',
62	    r'\$\s*([\d.]+)\s*(?:per|/)\s*(?:transaction|request|call|order)',
63	]

66	class FlowPositionEngine:
67	    def __init__(self, research_fn: Callable, llm_fn: Optional[Callable] = None, max_calls: int = 15):
68	        self.research_fn = research_fn
69	        self.llm_fn = llm_fn
70	        self.max_calls = max_calls
71	        self.calls_used = 0
72	
73	    def scan(self, topic: str, founder: Optional[FounderProfile] = None) -> list[FlowPosition]:
74	        raw_results = self._gather_raw(topic)
75	        if not raw_results:
76	            return []
77

91	
92	    def _gather_raw(self, topic: str) -> str:
93	        parts = []

108	        prompt = POSITION_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(topic=topic, text=raw_results[:3000])
109	        try:
110	            result = self.llm_fn(prompt)

113	            if not isinstance(result, list):

115	        except Exception as e:

118

121	            if not isinstance(item, dict):
122	                continue
123	            pos_type = item.get("position_type", "GATEWAY")
124	            if pos_type not in VALID_POSITION_TYPES:

134	                switching_cost=float(item.get("switching_cost", 0)),
135	                alternative_count=int(item.get("alternative_count", 0)),
136	                network_effect=float(item.get("network_effect", 0)),
137	                build_complexity=float(item.get("build_complexity", 0)),
138	                capital_required=float(item.get("capital_required", 0)),
139	                time_to_first_flow=int(item.get("time_to_first_flow", 0)),
140	                confidence="[T]",
141	                sources=[],
142	            ))
143	        return positions
144	
145	    def _extract_positions_heuristic(self, topic: str, raw_results: str) -> list[FlowPosition]:
146	        text_lower = raw_results.lower()
147	        positions = []
148	
149	        for pos_type, keywords in KEYWORD_CLUSTERS.items():
150	            matches = sum(1 for kw in keywords if kw in text_lower)
151	            if matches < 2:
152	                continue
153	
154	            volume = self._extract_volume(raw_results)
155	            take_rate = self._extract_take_rate(raw_results)
156	
157	            positions.append(FlowPosition(
158	                flow_name=f"{topic} {pos_type.lower()}",
159	                position_type=pos_type,
160	                market="global",
161	                description=f"Detected via keyword cluster ({matches}/{len(keywords)} keywords matched)",
162	                estimated_daily_volume=volume,
163	                take_rate=take_rate,
164	                avg_transaction_value=self._extract_avg_value(raw_results),
165	                switching_cost=0.3 if pos_type in ("BOTTLENECK", "STANDARD") else 0.1,
166	                alternative_count=self._extract_alternative_count(raw_results),
167	                network_effect=0.5 if pos_type == "AGGREGATOR" else 0.1,
168	                build_complexity=0.7 if pos_type == "BOTTLENECK" else 0.4,
169	                confidence="[?]",
170	                sources=[],
171	            ))
172	
173	        return positions
174	
175	    def _extract_volume(self, text: str) -> float:
176	        for pattern, multiplier in VOLUME_PATTERNS:
177	            match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)
178	            if match:

Here are the results from my search on "AI agent builder freelance to marketplace transition revenue compound 2026":

## Key Findings

### Market Size & Growth

The global AI agents market reached $7.63 billion in 2025 and is projected to explode to $182.97 billion by 2033—a staggering 49.6% compound annual growth rate. Additionally, as of early 2025, the global AI agent market is estimated to be valued between $5.3 billion and $5.4 billion, with modest projections estimating the market will reach $7.6 billion by 2025, growing at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 25–30%.

### Freelance to Marketplace/Product Transition

Several sources discuss the pathway from freelance AI agent building to marketplace-based or productized revenue models:

Services (consulting) are faster to monetize—you can earn money within weeks. Products (SaaS, courses) take longer but scale better—you build once and earn recurring revenue indefinitely. Most successful creators do both: consulting in year one to fund product building, then transition to products in year two+ for scale.

Once the productised agent service is your spine, six other income streams stack on top of it. Stream one is custom agent builds at $5K-$15K each — the cash-flow engine. Stream two is productised agent SaaS at $97-$997/month per customer — recurring revenue. Stream five is marketplace agent templates sold on Gumroad and n8n.io at $47-$497 each.

### Compounding & Revenue Models

Each experiment builds knowledge and capability that compounds over time. The first $500 MRR is the hardest milestone because everything is manual and nothing compounds yet.

Unlike traditional web development where you build something and hand it over, AI agents require ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and improvement — creating natural recurring revenue streams.

### AI Agent Marketplaces in 2026

In Q2 2026, eight marketplaces matter. The AI agent economy split into distinct storefronts over the last eighteen months. Anthropic runs Claude Skills as a first-party directory tied to the Claude product surface. OpenAI's GPT Store sits inside ChatGPT and pays a revenue share on usage.

Pricing models diverge sharply: GPT Store pays revenue share on usage, Claude Skills is currently free distribution, Replit runs a direct-sale model, and Cloudflare bills on inference.

Multi-Marketplace Is the Winning Strategy: Single-marketplace listings cap reach. The agencies getting traction in 2026 publish the same capability as a Skill, a GPT, an MCP server, and a Hugging Face Space with platform-specific tuning.

An AI gateway is a middleware layer that sits between applications and LLM providers (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google). Its architecture typically includes a routing engine that directs requests to the appropriate model, a policy layer for enforcing rate limits and access controls, an observability stack for logging and cost tracking, and a caching layer to reduce redundant API calls. This architecture allows organizations to manage multi-model deployments from a single control plane.

Key features include LLM routing and AI traffic management across multiple providers, with fallbacks when models fail or degrade; usage governance through cost controls, rate limiting and quota enforcement; security and compliance via centralized authorization, request filtering and data handling policies; and AI observability with logs and metrics.

### Why Traditional API Gateways Fall Short
Traditional API gateways weren't built for AI workloads. They excel at routing microservice traffic and handle authentication beautifully, but they can't count tokens, can't manage streaming responses, and can't enforce content-level security. Enter the AI gateway—a specialized proxy designed for Large Language Model (LLM) traffic.

Here's a comprehensive overview of OpenRouter's founding story and journey to its $1.3B valuation:

## OpenRouter: Founding Story & Rise to $1.3B

### The Founder: Alex Atallah

Alex Atallah is a Stanford CS graduate who previously worked at Palantir. He co-founded NFT marketplace OpenSea in late 2017 and served as its CTO through the platform's rise to over $4 billion in monthly trading volume. His net worth once exceeded $2 billion. He departed OpenSea in 2022, just before the ChatGPT launch reshaped the tech landscape.

### The Origin of OpenRouter (2023)

Alex Atallah co-founded OpenRouter in February/March 2023, shortly after witnessing the emergence of open-source LLMs like Meta's LLaMA. The initial inspiration came after Atallah observed models like Stanford's Alpaca, which demonstrated that smaller teams could create competitive AI models with minimal resources. This suggested a future ecosystem with numerous specialized models, potentially requiring a marketplace to effectively navigate them.

He initially built Window AI, a browser extension letting users choose which LLM to use on any site, before co-founding OpenRouter in 2023 with Lewis, creator of the Plasmo browser extension framework. The company went through Y Combinator and quickly attracted developer attention as the number of available frontier models proliferated.

### What OpenRouter Does

OpenRouter is a unified API platform founded in early 2023 that aims to simplify the integration and optimization of AI models for developers while providing price transparency and reliability. OpenRouter's core product is a unified API that routes developer requests across more than 400 AI models from providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and DeepSeek. The platform handles failover, cost optimization, and performance benchmarking — positioning itself as the switching layer in an increasingly fragmented inference market.

### Growth Trajectory

Monthly customer spending through the platform grew from $800,000 in October 2024 to approximately $8 million in May 2025 — a ten-fold increase in seven months.

The platform processed over $100M in annualized inference spend by May 2025, up from roughly $10M in October 2024.

In April 2025, a mysterious model called "Quasar Alpha" launched on OpenRouter, and a few days later, everyone learned it was GPT-4.1 — OpenAI chose to exclusively debut it on OpenRouter.

### Funding History

1. **Seed + Series A (June 2025):** In February 2025, the company raised a $12.5 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, followed by a $28 million Series A round in April 2025 led by Menlo Ventures. The combined $40 million funding valued the company at approximately $500 million.

2. **Series B (May 2026):** OpenRouter raised a hefty $113 million Series B led by CapitalG, the growth venture fund of Google parent company Alphabet. While the startup didn't disclose its new valuation, The New York Times reports that it landed at about $1.3 billion post-money.

The Series B round drew a roster of strategic corporate venture investors: NVentures (Nvidia's venture arm), ServiceNow Ventures, MongoDB Ventures, Snowflake Ventures, and Databricks Ventures all participated, alongside returning backers Andreessen Horowitz and Menlo Ventures.

### Current Scale

OpenRouter was founded in 2023 and became a unicorn in 2026, reaching the milestone in 3 years. The platform now serves 8 million users and processes roughly 100 trillion tokens monthly, a fivefold increase in six months. As of April 2026, the company has 62 employees.
